author: More Perfect Union
description:
Trump won Arkansas 3 times. But now, farmers are outraged by skyrocketing diesel prices.

Could fallout from the Iran War mean flipping the Senate seat held by Tom Cotton, a notorious war hawk?

We went to Arkansas to find out.

Host: @lakeeffectbeth
Producer: @yuremaperezhinojosa
Editor: Anthony Mascorro
Videographers: Ian McKenna, Ryan Goble
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: We Went to Arkansas. Farmers Are Outraged — And It Could Swing the Election.

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Florida has the worst healthcare crisis in America right now.
Nearly 450,000 people lost their ACA coverage this year, the most of any state in the country.

We took Democrat Angie Nixon to Putnam County, which Trump won with nearly 74%.
It has the worth health score in the entire state.

Angie Nixon pitched Medicare For All to Trump voters, a message she's hoping will take her to Congress in November.
